source.title: Sinew of Light
source.description:
Grok'lo will arrange a meeting with special crafter once you find a suitable string to go with that giant bat wing.

Grok'lo recommend finding best string possible.

<Grok'lo smiles under his helmet>

Dragon Sinew definitely best string.
source.objective:
Defeat Solistrasza and obtain a Mature Light Dragon Sinew, then bring it to Grok'lo at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Provided item:
source.progress: Have you found a string to go with your bat wing?
source.completion:
Now that's a string! Grok'lo loves bright things!

<Grok'lo nods>

Ah, no doubt in Grok'lo's head you'll get a lot of gold for this when it's made into a bow.
